variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium polished design exploration board for Alarma native iPhone sleep app, in Spanish. Landscape board, warm ivory outside phones, TWO large straight-on tall iPhone screens side by side, screen contents completely visible with safe areas, no hands, no perspective. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED nocturnal backdrop: preserve its blue moonlit lake, mountains, pine trees and moon; reuse it as the actual full-screen background rather than inventing a new landscape. Same screen in two states: LEFT active night listening, RIGHT upward finishing gesture halfway, shown by the handle's lifted position and subtle upward trail, no finger. Elegant ivory serif headings, restrained rounded system numerals, muted cyan/ivory accents, calm and legible low-light UI. Exact main copy: 'Buenas noches', 'ALARMA INTELIGENTE', '07:00 – 07:30', 'Límite: 07:30', 'Escuchando el ambiente', 'Micrófono activo'. One discreet pause-microphone control. No conventional finish button, no confirmation dialog, no bottom tab bar while night is active. The sound visual represents microphone amplitude, not sleep stages. No invented scores, breathing coaching, health claims or extra features. This is a design concept, not a real app screenshot. Board title outside phones 'A · Halo'. A DISTINCT RADIAL composition: central softly luminous circular audio waveform made of short irregular ivory radial strokes surrounding the time range (split as '07:00' then small 'a' then '07:30' if needed to fit). Keep glow very restrained, clear ample empty sky, the approved moon visible away from the ring. Small listening state under circle. Bottom swipe is a minimal thin vertical path with a round ivory upward chevron handle, LEFT resting at foot, RIGHT halfway raised, no heavy pill tube. Greeting centred near top. Feeling: spacious, intimate, refined. Keep all essential copy clearly legible.
